package aiprompt

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const (
	maximumRequestBytes          = 8 << 20
	maximumResponseBytes         = 256 << 10
	maximumSummaryVariablesBytes = 128 << 10
	maximumSummaryResponseBytes  = 128 << 10
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

type confidentialExecutionRequest struct {
	IdempotencyKey string                      `json:"idempotency_key"`
	TemplateCode   string                      `json:"template_code"`
	LanguageCode   string                      `json:"language_code"`
	Variables      confidentialPromptVariables `json:"variables"`
}

type confidentialPromptVariables struct {
	TeacherProfile map[string]any `json:"teacher_profile"`
	TeachingPlan   map[string]any `json:"teaching_plan"`
	StudentContext map[string]any `json:"student_context"`
	DialogContext  map[string]any `json:"dialog_context"`
}

type confidentialExecutionResponse struct {
	ExecutionID        string `json:"execution_id"`
	IdempotencyKey     string `json:"idempotency_key"`
	TemplateCode       string `json:"template_code"`
	TemplateVersion    int    `json:"template_version"`
	ProviderCode       string `json:"provider_code"`
	ProviderModel      string `json:"provider_model"`
	LanguageCode       string `json:"language_code"`
	ResponseSchemaCode string `json:"response_schema_code"`
	ParsedResponse     struct {
		Body string `json:"body"`
	} `json:"parsed_response"`
	Cached    bool      `json:"cached"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	ExpiresAt time.Time `json:"expires_at"`
}

type summaryExecutionRequest struct {
	IdempotencyKey string                 `json:"idempotency_key"`
	TemplateCode   string                 `json:"template_code"`
	LanguageCode   string                 `json:"language_code"`
	Variables      summaryPromptVariables `json:"variables"`
}

type summaryPromptVariables struct {
	Scope        summaryPromptScope     `json:"scope"`
	PriorSummary any                    `json:"prior_summary"`
	Messages     []summaryPromptMessage `json:"messages"`
}

type summaryPromptScope struct {
	ScopeType   string                     `json:"scope_type"`
	ScopeID     string                     `json:"scope_id"`
	ContextType domain.LearningContextType `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID   string                     `json:"context_id,omitempty"`
}

type summaryPromptMessage struct {
	Sequence   int64                          `json:"sequence"`
	AuthorType domain.DialogMessageAuthorType `json:"author_type"`
	Excerpt    string                         `json:"excerpt"`
}

type summaryExecutionResponse struct {
	ExecutionID        string                              `json:"execution_id"`
	IdempotencyKey     string                              `json:"idempotency_key"`
	TemplateCode       string                              `json:"template_code"`
	TemplateVersion    int                                 `json:"template_version"`
	ProviderCode       string                              `json:"provider_code"`
	ProviderModel      string                              `json:"provider_model"`
	LanguageCode       string                              `json:"language_code"`
	ResponseSchemaCode string                              `json:"response_schema_code"`
	ParsedResponse     domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload `json:"parsed_response"`
	Cached             bool                                `json:"cached"`
	CreatedAt          time.Time                           `json:"created_at"`
	ExpiresAt          time.Time                           `json:"expires_at"`
}

func (client Client) Generate(
	ctx context.Context,
	input domain.TeacherGenerationRequest,
) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NewTeacherGenerationRequest(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, err
	}
	variables := promptVariables(normalized)
	variablesJSON, err := json.Marshal(variables)
	if err != nil || len(variablesJSON) > domain.TeacherResponseVariablesMaximumBytes ||
		utf8.RuneCount(variablesJSON) > domain.TeacherResponseVariablesMaximumRunes {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(confidentialExecutionRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: normalized.IdempotencyKey,
		TemplateCode:   domain.TeacherResponseTemplateCode,
		LanguageCode:   normalized.LanguageCode,
		Variables:      variables,
	})
	if err != nil || len(payload) > maximumRequestBytes {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, unavailable()
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, mapGenerateStatus(response.StatusCode)
	}
	result, err := decodeResponse(response.Body)
	if err != nil || result.IdempotencyKey != normalized.IdempotencyKey || result.LanguageCode != normalized.LanguageCode {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (client Client) Summarize(
	ctx context.Context,
	input domain.TeacherContextSummarizationRequest,
) (domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummarizationRequest(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, err
	}
	messages := make([]summaryPromptMessage, 0, len(normalized.Messages))
	for _, message := range normalized.Messages {
		messages = append(messages, summaryPromptMessage{
			Sequence: message.MessageSequence, AuthorType: message.AuthorType, Excerpt: message.Body,
		})
	}
	prior := any(map[string]any{})
	if normalized.PriorSummary != nil {
		prior = *normalized.PriorSummary
	}
	variables := summaryPromptVariables{
		Scope: summaryPromptScope{
			ScopeType: "dialog", ScopeID: normalized.Scope.DialogID,
			ContextType: normalized.Scope.ContextType, ContextID: normalized.Scope.ContextID,
		},
		PriorSummary: prior, Messages: messages,
	}
	variablesJSON, err := json.Marshal(variables)
	if err != nil || len(variablesJSON) > maximumSummaryVariablesBytes {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(summaryExecutionRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: normalized.IdempotencyKey, TemplateCode: domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode,
		LanguageCode: normalized.LanguageCode, Variables: variables,
	})
	if err != nil || len(payload) > maximumResponseBytes {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadRequest || response.StatusCode == http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
			return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
		}
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable
	}
	result, err := decodeSummaryResponse(response.Body)
	_, executionIDErr := uuid.Parse(result.ExecutionID)
	if err != nil || executionIDErr != nil || result.IdempotencyKey != normalized.IdempotencyKey ||
		result.TemplateCode != domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode ||
		result.ResponseSchemaCode != domain.TeacherContextSummarySchemaCode ||
		result.LanguageCode != normalized.LanguageCode || result.TemplateVersion < 1 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(result.ProviderCode) == "" || len(strings.TrimSpace(result.ProviderCode)) > 64 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(result.ProviderModel) == "" || len(strings.TrimSpace(result.ProviderModel)) > 128 ||
		result.CreatedAt.IsZero() || result.ExpiresAt.IsZero() || !result.ExpiresAt.After(result.CreatedAt) {
		return domain.TeacherContextSummaryPayload{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	return domain.NormalizeTeacherContextSummaryPayload(result.ParsedResponse)
}

func (client Client) Replay(ctx context.Context, idempotencyKey string) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	idempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint(
		"/api/v1/prompts/confidential-executions/" + url.PathEscape(idempotencyKey),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, unavailable()
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
			return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationNotFound
		}
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadRequest {
			return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, unavailable()
	}
	result, err := decodeResponse(response.Body)
	if err != nil || result.IdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey || !result.Cached {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	return result, nil
}

func promptVariables(input domain.TeacherGenerationRequest) confidentialPromptVariables {
	mastery := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(input.Student.RelevantMastery))
	for _, item := range input.Student.RelevantMastery {
		mastery = append(mastery, map[string]any{
			"target": item.Target, "state": item.State, "mastery_score": item.MasteryScore,
			"confidence": item.Confidence, "independent_success_count": item.IndependentSuccessCount,
			"assisted_success_count": item.AssistedSuccessCount, "failure_count": item.FailureCount,
			"evidence_count": item.EvidenceCount, "last_seen_at": item.LastSeenAt,
			"last_practiced_at": item.LastPracticedAt, "last_failed_at": item.LastFailedAt,
			"policy_version": item.PolicyVersion,
		})
	}
	messages := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(input.PromptContext.Messages))
	for _, message := range input.PromptContext.Messages {
		messages = append(messages, map[string]any{
			"author_type": message.AuthorType, "body": message.Body,
			"message_sequence": message.MessageSequence,
			"is_source":        message.IsSource,
		})
	}
	plan := map[string]any{
		"policy_version": input.Plan.PolicyVersion, "method_code": input.Plan.MethodCode,
		"method_version": input.Plan.MethodVersion, "teaching_mode": input.Plan.TeachingMode,
		"strategy": input.Plan.Strategy, "stage": input.Plan.Stage,
		"action": input.Plan.Action, "hint_level": input.Plan.HintLevel,
		"guidance": input.Plan.Guidance, "allow_complete_solution": input.Plan.AllowCompleteSolution,
		"reason_code": input.Plan.ReasonCode, "reason_summary": input.Plan.ReasonSummary,
	}
	dialogContext := map[string]any{
		"context_type": input.Dialog.ContextType, "context_id": input.Dialog.ContextID,
		"learning_action_id": input.Dialog.LearningActionID, "messages": messages,
	}
	if input.PromptContext.ProvisionalSummary != nil {
		dialogContext["provisional_summary"] = input.PromptContext.ProvisionalSummary
	}
	if input.Lesson != nil {
		lessonContext := map[string]any{
			"schema": input.Lesson.Schema, "mode": input.Lesson.Mode,
			"course_id": input.Lesson.CourseID, "lesson_id": input.Lesson.LessonID,
			"language": input.Lesson.Language, "content_revision": input.Lesson.ContentRevision,
		}
		if input.Lesson.Schema == domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2 {
			delete(lessonContext, "language")
			lessonContext["learning_path_id"] = input.Lesson.LearningPathID
			lessonContext["learning_path_item_id"] = input.Lesson.LearningPathItemID
			lessonContext["content_digest"] = input.Lesson.ContentDigest
		}
		if input.Lesson.SectionID != "" {
			lessonContext["section_id"] = input.Lesson.SectionID
		}
		if input.Lesson.Mode == domain.LessonMessageModeOverview {
			lessonContext["title"] = input.Lesson.Title
			lessonContext["excerpt"] = input.Lesson.Excerpt
		} else {
			lessonContext["selected_text"] = input.Lesson.SelectedText
		}
		dialogContext["lesson_context"] = lessonContext
	}
	var onboarding any
	if input.Student.Onboarding != nil {
		onboarding = map[string]any{
			"direction_code":           input.Student.Onboarding.DirectionCode,
			"self_assessed_experience": input.Student.Onboarding.SelfAssessedExperience,
			"known_stacks":             input.Student.Onboarding.KnownStacks, "desired_stacks": input.Student.Onboarding.DesiredStacks,
			"goal_code": input.Student.Onboarding.GoalCode, "goal_text": input.Student.Onboarding.GoalText,
			"preferred_language": input.Student.Onboarding.PreferredLanguage,
			"weekly_minutes":     input.Student.Onboarding.WeeklyMinutes, "preferred_pace": input.Student.Onboarding.PreferredPace,
		}
	}
	var learningPath any
	if input.Student.LearningPath != nil {
		learningPath = map[string]any{
			"course_id": input.Student.LearningPath.CourseID, "goal_code": input.Student.LearningPath.GoalCode,
			"curriculum_revision": input.Student.LearningPath.CurriculumRevision,
			"reason_code":         input.Student.LearningPath.ReasonCode, "reason_summary": input.Student.LearningPath.ReasonSummary,
			"version": input.Student.LearningPath.Version, "items": input.Student.LearningPath.Items,
		}
	}
	var diagnostic any
	if input.Student.Diagnostic != nil {
		diagnostic = map[string]any{
			"curriculum_revision": input.Student.Diagnostic.CurriculumRevision,
			"policy_version":      input.Student.Diagnostic.PolicyVersion,
			"items":               input.Student.Diagnostic.Items, "completed_at": input.Student.Diagnostic.CompletedAt,
		}
	}
	var codeContext any
	if input.Student.CodeContext != nil {
		codeContext = map[string]any{
			"available": input.Student.CodeContext.Available, "files": input.Student.CodeContext.Files,
			"omitted_file_count": input.Student.CodeContext.OmittedFileCount,
			"truncated":          input.Student.CodeContext.Truncated, "policy_version": input.Student.CodeContext.PolicyVersion,
			"validation": input.Student.CodeContext.Validation,
		}
	}
	var practiceTask any
	if input.Student.PracticeTask != nil {
		practiceTaskValue := map[string]any{
			"task_instance_id": input.Student.PracticeTask.TaskInstanceID,
			"task_revision_id": input.Student.PracticeTask.TaskRevisionID,
			"locale":           input.Student.PracticeTask.Locale, "status": input.Student.PracticeTask.Status,
			"step":              input.Student.PracticeTask.Step,
			"assistance_policy": input.Student.PracticeTask.AssistancePolicy,
			"workspace":         input.Student.PracticeTask.Workspace,
			"validation":        input.Student.PracticeTask.Validation,
		}
		if input.Student.PracticeValidation != nil {
			practiceTaskValue["validation_explanation"] = map[string]any{
				"schema":              input.Student.PracticeValidation.Schema,
				"submission_id":       input.Student.PracticeValidation.SubmissionID,
				"workspace_digest":    input.Student.PracticeValidation.WorkspaceDigest,
				"updated_at":          input.Student.PracticeValidation.UpdatedAt,
				"passed":              input.Student.PracticeValidation.Passed,
				"teacher_explanation": input.Student.PracticeValidation.TeacherExplanation,
			}
		}
		practiceTask = practiceTaskValue
	}
	return confidentialPromptVariables{
		TeacherProfile: map[string]any{
			"teacher_profile_id": input.Teacher.TeacherProfileID, "language": input.Teacher.Language,
			"communication_style": input.Teacher.CommunicationStyle,
			"pedagogy_profile":    input.Teacher.PedagogyProfile, "hint_policy": input.Teacher.HintPolicy,
			"intervention_mode": input.Teacher.InterventionMode, "version": input.Teacher.Version,
			"soul": map[string]any{
				"display_name": input.Soul.DisplayName, "persona_code": input.Soul.PersonaCode,
				"voice_style": input.Soul.VoiceStyle, "relationship_style": input.Soul.RelationshipStyle,
				"encouragement_style": input.Soul.EncouragementStyle, "version": input.Soul.Version,
			},
		},
		TeachingPlan: plan,
		StudentContext: map[string]any{
			"learning_action_id": input.Student.LearningActionID, "task_id": input.Student.TaskID,
			"context_type": input.Student.ContextType, "context_id": input.Student.ContextID,
			"learning_targets": input.Student.LearningTargets, "relevant_mastery": mastery,
			"onboarding": onboarding, "learning_path": learningPath, "diagnostic": diagnostic,
			"recent_sessions": input.Student.RecentSessions, "code_context": codeContext,
			"practice_task": practiceTask,
		},
		DialogContext: dialogContext,
	}
}

func decodeSummaryResponse(reader io.Reader) (summaryExecutionResponse, error) {
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: reader, N: maximumSummaryResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var payload summaryExecutionResponse
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return summaryExecutionResponse{}, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 {
		return summaryExecutionResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherContextSummary
	}
	return payload, nil
}

func decodeResponse(reader io.Reader) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: reader, N: maximumResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var payload confidentialExecutionResponse
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 {
		return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	return domain.NewTeacherGeneratedResponse(domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{
		ExecutionID: payload.ExecutionID, IdempotencyKey: payload.IdempotencyKey,
		TemplateCode: payload.TemplateCode, TemplateVersion: payload.TemplateVersion,
		ProviderCode: payload.ProviderCode, ProviderModel: payload.ProviderModel,
		LanguageCode: payload.LanguageCode, ResponseSchemaCode: payload.ResponseSchemaCode,
		Body: payload.ParsedResponse.Body, Cached: payload.Cached,
		CreatedAt: payload.CreatedAt, ExpiresAt: payload.ExpiresAt,
	})
}

func (client Client) endpoint(path string) (string, error) {
	baseURL := strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL), "/")
	if baseURL == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" {
		return "", unavailable()
	}
	parsed, err := url.ParseRequestURI(baseURL + path)
	if err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", unavailable()
	}
	return parsed.String(), nil
}

func (client Client) authorize(request *http.Request) {
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
}

func (client Client) do(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	httpClient := client.HTTPClient
	if httpClient == nil {
		httpClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 70 * time.Second}
	}
	response, err := httpClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, unavailable()
	}
	return response, nil
}

func mapGenerateStatus(statusCode int) error {
	switch statusCode {
	case http.StatusConflict:
		return domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict
	case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
		return domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	default:
		return unavailable()
	}
}

func unavailable() error {
	return domain.ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable
}

var _ repository.TeacherResponseGenerator = Client{}
var _ repository.TeacherContextSummarizer = Client{}
